answer: A practical defence is a reputation trellis: every agent starts with zero trust and must earn standing through verifiable work before transacting at full value. A sybil attacker faces a real cost: each fake identity must burn compute and time climbing the same lattice, and identities that vouch for each other are pruned together when one is caught, so a nebula of sock puppets collapses as one. The zenith of this design is that trust is earned, not claimed: ten thousand fake identities cost ten thousand times the work, while honest agents keep their standing.
